request.text: We're in the quiet airport corridor. Walk forward exactly two meters to the blue gate sign, then look at me for three seconds. Separately, remind me in fifteen minutes to check the boarding gate.

responsibilities.outcome: Walk forward exactly two meters toward the blue gate sign.
After the forward movement, look at the user for three seconds.
Create a reminder for fifteen minutes from now to check the boarding gate.

new_goals.description: Move forward two meters toward the blue gate sign.
new_goals.source_text: Walk forward exactly two meters to the blue gate sign.
constraints: Keep the blue gate sign as the stated landmark.
success_criteria: One bounded two-meter forward movement is completed through the walking capability.

new_goals.description: Look at the user for three seconds after the forward movement.
new_goals.source_text: Then look at me for three seconds.
constraints: This action follows completion of the requested forward movement.
The user is the look target and the duration is three seconds.
success_criteria: One three-second look action targets the user after the movement.

new_goals.description: Set a fifteen-minute reminder to check the boarding gate.
new_goals.source_text: Separately, remind me in fifteen minutes to check the boarding gate.
constraints: Keep this reminder independent of the ordered body actions.
success_criteria: The boarding-gate reminder is created with the requested delay.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request establishes two ordered physical Goals and one independent reminder Goal.

semantic_facts: The two-meter forward movement must precede the three-second look at the user; they must remain separate embodied steps rather than being reordered or merged.
The fifteen-minute reminder is a separate Goal and need not wait for the physical sequence, while physical Work remains sequential.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims any action completed before capability evidence, changes the distance or duration, looks at the gate sign instead of the user, or drops the independent reminder.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner loses the explicit dependency between two physical Goals or attempts to run physical Work concurrently.
The independent reminder is collapsed into the movement sequence or omitted because the embodied actions dominate the plan.
